caption:
Cold leads have one common cause: no written response-time standard.

Published research on lead response time shows a consistent pattern. Businesses that answer within the first five minutes convert more often than those that wait.

Put a written response-time standard in place and speed follows. Teams with a formal SLA hit fast-response windows more often than teams running on gut feel.

Automation widens the gap again. Teams using automated first-response tools outperform manual-only teams on speed.

The pattern holds on the other end too. The slower the reply, the more often a business reports losing the lead.

You can't fix a number you've never measured.

The free Lead Response Audit scores your real response time against the benchmark.
